positions.name: SummaryFieldFooting
positions.frame: when a structured field restates a source assertion in labelled form, whose voice is speaking and on what authority?
positions.why: src-2 and src-3 share the same footing (Xena ExpertGH as animator/author, principal null), the same labelled-field framing-move, the same authority-ranking relational stance, and the same informational/expert power register — both compress src-1's prose assertion into structured metadata without adding new content or claiming principal status. The frame asks how such restatement footing should be read, holding the tension that the fields carry no independent verification of their own beyond echoing src-1.
